nodes.title: Implement distance/normal-aware TSDF fusion with thin-wall and occlusion protection
acceptance: Lower-quality distant observations cannot erode or pull a stable higher-quality surface on the same side, while genuinely better close observations can still refine it
Observation arbitration uses distance, incidence angle, existing-versus-incoming surface orientation, confidence, and visibility instead of a distance-only lock
Opposite-facing surfaces of a thin wall remain distinct and scanning the adjoining room cannot update through the already observed wall
Deterministic synthetic tests cover near-then-far, far-then-near, grazing-angle, thin-wall front/back, occluded surface, revisit, and noisy-depth sequences
Quest profiling verifies bounded GPU memory and no unacceptable regression in integration frame time
evidence: Runtime/Core/TsdfFusionPolicy.cs and the Vulkan-parity TsdfFusionPolicy.hlsl reject occluded, lower-quality, opposite-facing, and inconsistent observations while allowing bounded better-quality and consistent revisit corrections

VolumeIntegration.compute derives the existing world-space normal from the confident TSDF gradient only near stable surfaces and fixes the upstream dimensional error that integrated approximately 30 cm behind a default surface; the protected band is now min(voxelMin, 1.25 voxels)=6.25 cm

The persistent volume layout remains exactly RG8_SNORM TSDF/confidence plus RGBA8 color/best-quality: 32 MiB + 64 MiB at 256^3. Direct Quest vkjson reports maxStorageBufferRange=128 MiB, maxMemoryAllocationSize=1 GiB, and maxImageDimension3D=2048; the fail-closed 128 MiB guard therefore applies to structured/storage buffers rather than legal 3D images

TsdfFusionPolicyTests deterministically pass near-then-far, far-then-near, grazing, 8 cm front/back thin-wall, occlusion, revisit, noisy-depth, corrected-band, and memory sequences; full EditMode result is 64 total, 59 passed, 0 failed, 5 intentional hardware/live skips

A real NVIDIA/Vulkan compute parity gate passes 1/1 for all HLSL arbitration outcomes; Android/Vulkan ARM64 APK cfe76ddd443a11dcf13b335cc1b037b32b359a43b12433e9d67b384fe442f8b2 builds without VolumeIntegration warnings and installs successfully

Physical Quest testing confirmed one-sided thin-wall protection works, but exposed oblique-wall incompleteness and a post-rollover Vulkan premature-free page fault. Remediation projects the back band into surface-normal space, accumulates repeated provisional oblique evidence below mesh confidence, fences rollover resource retirement, resets per-chunk temporal history, and bounds telemetry readbacks

The remediated policy passes 10 CPU tests plus a real-GPU parity gate, the full runtime suite has no mapper failures, and Android/Vulkan APK a8baf1f1d0432c56638af5bab25bdb0653b3129f67cc90bdf2a1afd59359a29e installs with data preservation; repeated >6-rollover physical acceptance remains pending
